description: Phase A3: Install Multi-Step Fast Router — enables instant multi-step commands like 'create a project called X'

commands.description: Update fast_router.py with multi-step pattern support
commands.command: git fetch origin && git checkout origin/phase-3/gui-operations -- src/intelligence/fast_router.py

commands.description: Update daemon main.py with latest fast_route_multi integration

commands.command: python -c "from src.intelligence.fast_router import fast_route_multi; print(fast_route_multi('create a project called TestApp'))"

commands.description: Start the agent daemon (will run in background)
Wait 3 seconds for agent to start, then test instant multi-step execution
commands.command: timeout /t 3 /nobreak >nul && curl -X POST http://localhost:8900/api/v1/task -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"instruction\": \"Create a project called BridgeTest in my Documents\"}"
